theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.markov_rossoJones_of_middle {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq1 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) {B : Type u_2} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] {N : ℕ} {s : ℕ → B} (hs : IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.HeckeFamily N (q - q⁻¹) 1 s) (t : B →ₗ[R] R) (ht1 : t 1 = 1) (hcyc : ∀ (x y : B), t (x * y) = t (y * x)) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), t (x * s k) = IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.zD q * t x) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (p : ℕ) (h : MiddleWeightTraces q n p) :
q ^ (2 * p) * (q ^ 2 + 1) ^ (n + 1) * t (IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.cox s n ^ p) = (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (q ^ 2) ^ m) * q ^ (p * (n + 2)) - (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 (n + 1), (q ^ 2) ^ m) * q ^ (p * n)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rossoJones_of_middle {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p : ℕ) (h : MiddleWeightTraces q n p) :
q ^ (2 * p) * (IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.W q (n + 1) * gam q n ^ p).trace = (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (q ^ 2) ^ m) * q ^ (p * (n + 2)) - (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 (n + 1), (q ^ 2) ^ m) * q ^ (p * n)

Prop

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_top {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p : ℕ) :
T (gam q n ^ p) (n + 1) = q ^ (n * p)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_zero {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p : ℕ) :
T (gam q n ^ p) 0 = q ^ (n * p)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_eq_top_iff {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin 2) :
ones u = n ↔ u = fun (x : Fin n) => 1

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin 2) :
ones u = 0 ↔ u = fun (x : Fin n) => 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.gam_pow_const {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (p : ℕ) :
((gam q n ^ p) (fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) = q ^ (n * p)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.cox_const_mul {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) {n : ℕ} (c : Fin 2) (X : Matrix (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) R) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (k : ℕ) :
k ≤ n → (IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.cox (IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.S q n) k * X) (fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) b = q ^ k * X (fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.S_const_mul {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) {n i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (c : Fin 2) (X : Matrix (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) R) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
(IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.S q n i * X) (fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) b = q * X (fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.S_const_row {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) {n i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (c : Fin 2) (v : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.S q n i (fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c) v = if v = fun (x : Fin (n + 1)) => c then q else 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rCheck_const_row {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q qi : R) (c : Fin 2) (b : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
IwahoriHecke.RMatrix.rCheck q qi (c, c) b = if b = (c, c) then q else 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.trace_W_eq_sum_T {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) {n : ℕ} (X : Matrix (Fin n → Fin 2) (Fin n → Fin 2) R) :
(IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.W q n * X).trace = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (q ^ 2) ^ m * T X m

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_le {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin 2) :
ones u ≤ n

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.prod_wt {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {n : ℕ} (q : R) (u : Fin n → Fin 2) :
∏ k : Fin n, IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.wt q (u k) = (q ^ 2) ^ ones u

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.wt_apply {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (x : Fin 2) :
IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.wt q x = if x = 1 then q ^ 2 else 1
